meaning:
Someone living at Shiloh or descended from Shelah (H7956)(?), only mentioned at Neh.11.5;
progenitors of: Zechariah (H2148W)
§ Shiloni, of Shiloh "peace bringer"
an inhabitant of Shiloh

elsewhere.note: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
